subject.title: feat: add publisher feed query and delta state

question: Should ClawHub adopt this durable publisher-feed revision/change protocol now, and should its stacked foundation be landed separately before this delta-state layer?
rationale: The decision fixes a long-lived public and stored-data contract shared by the open foundation and signed-route pull requests; correctness testing cannot determine whether this is the desired permanent protocol boundary.

options.title: Land the foundation first
options.body: Approve the publisher-feed model and RFC direction, land the narrow foundation separately, then rebase this PR to durable query/delta state with live upgrade and reset proof.

options.title: Adopt one combined protocol PR
options.body: Intentionally merge the stacked model and delta state together only after maintainers approve the combined public/storage contract and review it as one feature.

options.title: Pause the feed track
options.body: Defer the stored publisher-feed protocol until the RFC and signed-distribution design are settled.

recommendation.title: Land the foundation first
recommendation.body: Approve the publisher-feed model and RFC direction, land the narrow foundation separately, then rebase this PR to durable query/delta state with live upgrade and reset proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided dependency history identifies Patrick's prior exact-head review as materially shaping the shared publisher identity and feed foundation.
